summary: Iter50 covered the newly requested Vortex Guard (token projector, Excel/PDF export incl. wali-kelas access, live proctor) + Face/Barcode PresenceCard + Inventory full package (rooms CRUD, stats, activity, lookup, return-condition Rusak/Hilang). Backend: 26/26 passed via /app/backend/tests/test_iter50_vortex_inv.py (JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter50.xml). Frontend: Playwright smoke of /vortex-guard (guru), /face-attendance, /attendance, /inventory (admin & siswa) all green. Token projector shows real token 'MAT123'; LiveProctor renders 3 student tiles with filters/total-violations; wali kelas (Guru Vortex) sees UAS exam with exam-homeroom-* badge + export buttons but NO exam-token (correct - not owner). Barcode wedge scan of NISN 0012345678 produces big PresenceCard with gate-result-name 'Siswa Vortex' and gate-result-label. Unknown code produces gate-result-error. Inventory tabs render on admin (dashboard/items/requests/rooms/activity), QR manual lookup for INV-001 opens inv-drawer. Siswa inventory correctly hides dashboard/activity/add-button and still shows borrow buttons.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py is now 6528 lines - the monolith continues to grow. Splitting Vortex Guard section (lines 2267-2600 + 6254-6393) and Inventory (lines 1600-1770 + 6395-6513) into separate modules is strongly recommended.

In backend/server.py L2370 `_homeroom_kelas` runs an unindexed find on db.classes.homeroom_teacher_id each request; consider caching per-request or adding a Mongo index to avoid overhead when guru hits /exams or /exams/{id}/export.

GET /api/exams/{eid}/export calls `_exam_viewer` which uses dscope but then roster uses dscope(user) too - this works but if `is_demo` scopes diverge (unlikely) it would miss students. Current behaviour verified correct.

LiveProctor filter keys use Indonesian ('semua' instead of 'all'); the request mentioned 'proctor-filter-*' pattern so this is acceptable, but documenting the keyset ('semua','mengerjakan','melanggar','belum','selesai') in a code comment would help future testers.

PATCH /api/borrow/{id} takes `status`/`return_condition` as query params rather than JSON body - unusual REST style but matches existing contract and the frontend. Documented in LoansView.jsx via `act(id, status)` call.
DELETE /api/inventory-rooms/{rid} correctly blocks when items still reference the room; however DELETE returns 400 instead of 409 Conflict which would be more semantically correct.
Face Attendance page uses OPS allow-list for access, good; however `/face-attendance` loads MediaDevices even for unauthorized users briefly (before role check). Minor privacy nit.
